name: aave.borrow
description: Borrow variable-rate debt with explicit collateral/health bounds.

max_fee_eth.description: Maximum total native ETH gas cost. Preparation adds 20% gas-unit and up to 50% fee-quote headroom, including priority fees, within this cap. Changes inside the approved envelope do not require a new gas approval. Fresh USD quotes must remain within the separate displayed approval ceilings.

position.description: Stable accounting position identity for this refundable account.

AccountingLocation.description: A link identifies principal flow; application-owned receipt verification proves its cash/position legs.

maximum_costs.description: Complete fee ceilings by exact asset, shared across all stages and treatments.

CostTreatment.description: Prevent a proved expense included in a repayment/supply debit being charged twice.

oneOf.description:
Venue-calculated additional cash debit explicitly consented to by the
user. `CostBound.amount` is the finite upfront reservation, not a cap
on the ultimately proved fee. Supported only by narrowly reviewed
standalone operations.
Withheld from the gross proved credit, applied exactly once by the ledger.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Fresh exact approval for one linked authority revision, never a second fill owner.

A bounded noncustodial order or other protocol escrow lifecycle. The
ratio is minimum output atoms per filled input atom; fees are reserved
separately through `maximum_costs`.

A noncustodial escrow whose finalized fill becomes a typed position,
rather than spendable wallet credit. Refunds remain wallet cash.

conditional_position.description:
Optional non-custodial exposure created only when some escrow
input is finalized as filled. A no-fill cancellation proves zero.

oneOf.description:
A protocol request whose placement is pending and whose eventual
keeper outcome may change only these exact, anchored positions. This
does not represent wallet cash or escrow principal.

conditional_credits.description:
Optional cumulative wallet proceeds that may arise from a
finalized keeper fill. They are never available while the request
is merely placed; each positive progress row must pair with one
exact UsableCredit to `wallet_resource`.

conditional_pnl.description:
Optional realized PnL events that may exist only after a finalized
fill. Open/cancelled requests carry no rows.

protection.description:
Optional, explicitly reviewed reduce-only protection envelope.
Shared position locks are never inferred from a request's name;
adapters supply this only when the protocol binds the request to
the exact anchored position and threshold.

oneOf.description:
A bounded typed position movement. Unlike the legacy `Position`
constraint, this binds the exact protocol position kind.

An optional typed increase used only when a protocol may produce a
newly attributable position claim or no claim at all. Any present
effect remains bound to this exact key, kind and maximum.

Optional refundable account rent, for idempotent account-creation
instructions that can succeed without funding when the account appears
between preview and execution. When nonzero, adapters must emit a
balanced cash debit, typed refundable position and origin link.
Cumulative, receipt-backed lifecycle for rent-bearing accounts.
Long/short exposure quantities, never custody or borrowed principal.
Native-asset segregated margin exposure; the corresponding loan remains separate debt.
Realized collateral only; mark-to-market and unrealized PnL are excluded.

Bounds a finalized realized PnL event attached to an exact derivative
position. This is not cash, a credit, or a budget debit; the proved
wallet payout remains a separate effect.

Binds a protocol fee's native denomination to its separately accounted
typed Cost. This constraint creates no ledger movement or extra budget.

PendingRequestCreditBound.description:
Bounds a request's conditional proceeds in one exact wallet asset. The
same asset may be used by several requests, but may occur only once within
one request's bound set.

maximum_credit.description:
Optional venue/approval-defined upper limit. `None` avoids inventing
a cap for legitimate proceeds whose protocol amount is not bounded at
request creation.

asset.description: PnL denomination, which may differ from the derivative notional asset.

position_lock_resource.description:
Exact position-scoped reservation shared by compatible protection
siblings. Empty on legacy records, which cannot grant a new lease.

PositionAnchor.description: Broker-owned previously proved backing. JSON evidence is interpreted by the reviewed application.

oneOf.description:
Protocol-owned liquidity position backed by one or more independently
accounted underlying assets. Receipt units stay in anchor evidence.

Application-reported investment equity, with units and redemption
restrictions retained in its verified anchor evidence.
Cash committed to a position's margin, distinct from exposure units.

Assets held by a noncustodial protocol request or order. This balance
is not wallet cash and becomes usable only after separately verified
refund or settlement evidence.

Refundable native value held as rent in a wallet-owned account. This is
distinct from protocol collateral and remains an asset until returned.

Quantity.description: Canonical arbitrary-precision unsigned atomic units, serialized as a string.

ResourceId.description: Resolved physical custody/signer identity, never merely a user-provided alias.

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

action_deadline.description: Broker-resolved relative deadline, immutable for this plan attempt.

binding.description: Frozen exact execution fields and enforceable bounds, excluding observation times.

coverage: Rust implementation; synthetic and fixed-fork evidence recorded separately. Human/mainnet acceptance remains pending.
completion: Writes require canonical original transaction proof, confirmations, bounded actual gas, application-specific events and inclusion-block post-state.

semantics.amount: Exact decimal asset quantity; no floating-point conversion or rounding.
semantics.bounded_all: Supported full-balance operations require finite max_amount. Cash sweeps freeze observed units; full Aave repayment/withdrawal proves zero remaining scaled debt/claim. Every actual write receives a fresh preview and authorization.
semantics.deadline_example: Fixed schema illustration; replace with the current Unix timestamp plus 120 seconds before preview.
semantics.market: Optional exact enabled pool address; omission preserves the configured legacy default. Market identity is immutable within authorization.

max_cumulative_borrow.description:
Gross new variable debt, in underlying units, across this market/asset's
borrowing steps. Includes finite mint rounding; repayment never refunds.

plan_permission.fixed_fields: All remaining fields, including market, asset, recipient, collateral setting and risk limits.

semantics.retry: Reconcile the original persisted hash, never blind replay.
semantics.risk: Health factor and debt limits are fresh execution constraints, not guarantees against later interest, price changes or liquidation.

a caller must supply independent GoFin pricing evidence before policy can enforce them.

BridgeExecuteIntentInput.description:
Provider-neutral scope for a named logical bridge step. A plan approves
this identity and its bounds before a quote or route has been selected.

bounds.description: Human-selected execution bounds; quote-time hints alone grant no write scope.

Quantity.description: Canonical arbitrary-precision unsigned atomic units, serialized as a string.

input_schema.description:
The plan declaration uses the intent form; each execution uses one saved
child nomination. The disjoint field sets keep both contracts explicit.

coverage: Plan review binds exact wallet, source and destination assets, recipient, refund scope, provider set, quantity interval and finite financial bounds without requesting or selecting a quote. it to the physical `BridgeIntent.wallet` resource before provider access.

cctp.funding_hyperliquid: CCTP to Arbitrum owner wallet, then explicit hyperliquid.account.deposit and verified account credit

bidirectional Ethereum/Base ETH and verified StandardBridge ERC-20 pairs; separate withdrawal prove/finalize stages

name: bridge.routes
description: Discover indicative bridge routes by exact source asset and destination chain, with provider-specific availability and independently verified candidate token identities.

name: bridge.status
description: Reconcile a saved bridge transfer without requesting new authority or resubmitting a wallet step.

settlement_accounting.description: Optional idempotent plan-accounting reconciliation derived from the immutable verified settlement proof; separate from proof effects.

coverage: Reconciles saved CCTP, Base canonical, Relay and Canonical Inbox transfers from protected quote/source evidence; unused quotes are not financial pending state.
completion: CCTP requires the original message and canonical native-USDC mint receipt; burn and attestation alone remain intermediate. Relay settles only after exact reviewed-router or direct-order-tag proof and the configured destination confirmation policy. Canonical settles only after the source-derived type-0x64 child transaction and configured destination confirmation policy match the saved message locator. Repeated status reads include the persisted typed credit, costs and sanitized proof identity; verified measured plan costs may also appear separately as settlement_accounting without changing that proof.

semantics.provider_identity: saved provider only; no fallback or route switching
semantics.settlement_accounting: optional idempotent measured cost accounting is returned separately from immutable proof effects

name: bridge.transfer
description: Prepare or execute one persisted bridge approval, source deposit, Base withdrawal proof/finalization or CCTP destination mint under its exact or named-plan authority.

BridgeBounds.description:
All caps are explicit and asset-denominated. USD caps use integer microdollars;
a caller must supply independent GoFin pricing evidence before policy can enforce them.

Quantity.description: Canonical arbitrary-precision unsigned atomic units, serialized as a string.

bounds.description: Human-selected execution bounds; quote-time hints alone grant no write scope.

coverage: CCTP V2 supports all six directed native-USDC routes between Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum, and EVM-source transfers to Solana mainnet-beta, in Standard (default) and Fast modes with explicit mint. Solana requires an enrolled destination signer, existing native-USDC ATA, SOL gas and a separate nonrefundable nonce-account funding cap. Relay handles quote-dependent exact EVM assets and mainnet-beta SOL/SPL/Token-2022 in both directions; only fully validated Solana source transactions are executable. Base canonical handles ETH and verified ERC-20 pairs in both directions, including deferred withdrawal proof/finalization stages. Canonical Inbox handles native ETH from Ethereum Mainnet to Arbitrum One or Robinhood Chain when the destination is the same EOA; that route has no refund path.
completion: Each wallet step is a separate immutable operation. Source proof moves principal to nonspendable transit; destination settlement remains pending until the original provider's exact destination proof and configured finality are verified.

semantics.financial_authorization: fresh per-write Touch ID, one finite transfer-boundary grant, or one named-plan revision with each exact bridge step listed separately
semantics.named_plan_support: adapter-reviewed one step per bridge.transfer input; every step binds the same persisted transfer and exact step ID/kind, and selected BridgeBounds are independently enforced
semantics.request_identity: each step has its own operation ID; uncertain submissions reconcile under the original ID; quote refresh stays on the persisted provider and route
semantics.source_and_destination: reviewed EVM networks and Solana mainnet-beta; Relay supports exact external Solana recipient without enrollment

name: coinbase.withdraw
description: Send an exact USDC amount from an enrolled Coinbase Advanced account to an enrolled Base wallet with explicit consent to Coinbase-calculated fees and a finite fee accounting reserve.

feeMode.description: Explicitly consent to Coinbase-calculated network fees; the actual fee is known after processing.

feeReserveUsdc.description: Positive finite accounting reservation and attention threshold, not a fee estimate or Coinbase-enforced maximum.

travelRuleData.description: Optional Coinbase Travel Rule data for the enrolled self-hosted wallet. Supply exact beneficiary name and ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country when required by your Coinbase entity.

coverage: Coinbase App v2 send; enrolled Base native USDC destination proof and original transaction reconciliation.
completion: Submission acceptance is not settlement. Completion requires the original completed native transaction, actual Coinbase fee and signed source debit, plus an independent receipt for exact principal on Base.

semantics.nativeIdempotency: broker-generated UUIDv4, persisted before dispatch and reused for reconciliation only

name: coinbaseexchange.cancel-order
description: Cancel the verified open remainder of one Coinbase Exchange order.
coverage: One exact Exchange order ID linked to one unresolved Fin create-order operation; cancel-all is not supported.
completion: The original order and fills remain owned by the original operation; cancellation is complete only after authoritative terminal order evidence.

name: coinbaseexchange.create-account-report
description: Request a Coinbase Exchange account-history report for one exact native account and date interval.
coverage: Requests an account report scoped to one account verified under the enrolled Exchange profile. Date range and exact native account ID are fixed in the reviewed request; report files are never fetched.
completion: Requires a captured report ID followed by exact profile, account, date-range, format, and ready-status readback. An uncertain POST is never replayed.

name: coinbaseexchange.create-balance-report
description: Request a Coinbase Exchange balance statement for one exact historical timestamp.
coverage: Requests a CSV or PDF balance report at one exact timestamp for the enrolled Exchange profile. Report creation is a separately authorized non-trading configuration action; generated files are never fetched or followed by Fin.
completion: The operation completes only after the captured POST receipt's native report ID is polled and GET /reports/{report_id} reports ready for the exact enrolled profile and report type. An uncertain POST is never replayed.

name: coinbaseexchange.create-fills-report
description: Request a Coinbase Exchange fills report for one exact product and date interval.
coverage: Requests a fills report scoped to one verified Exchange product and the enrolled profile. Date range and product ID are fixed in the reviewed request; report files are never fetched.
completion: Requires a captured report ID followed by exact profile, product, date-range, format, and ready-status readback. An uncertain POST is never replayed.

name: coinbaseexchange.create-order
description: Prepare and submit one bounded Coinbase Exchange spot limit order.
coverage: Exchange spot limit orders only; the official Exchange REST API has no preview route, so preparation validates exact product metadata, protected fee tier, spendable account balance, and the frozen limit request locally.
completion: Submission acceptance is not settlement; order identity and every fill must be reconciled before balances are treated as final.

semantics.preview: local exact validation; no venue preview endpoint

name: coinbaseexchange.create-otc-fills-report
description: Request a Coinbase Exchange OTC fills report for one exact product and date interval.
coverage: Requests an OTC fills report scoped to one verified Exchange product and the enrolled profile. Date range and product ID are fixed in the reviewed request; report files are never fetched.
completion: Requires a captured report ID followed by exact profile, product, date-range, format, and ready-status readback. An uncertain POST is never replayed.

name: coinbaseexchange.create-profile
description: Create a Coinbase Exchange profile.
coverage: Creates an Exchange profile through its native REST route after binding the initiating enrolled profile and checking current native state.
completion: Completes only after a captured successful native response and exact GET /profiles readback. Lost or invalid responses remain unknown and are never replayed. Newly created profiles require separate credential enrollment before use.

name: jupiter.limit.cancel
description: Cancel an open wallet-owned Trigger V1 order and return its remaining escrow. GoFin-created orders use exact parent-bound recovery; externally created orders use a fresh standalone approval.

order_key.description: Exact order account. Required for externally created orders; a named-plan recovery step inherits it from the earlier create step.

original_operation_id.description: Required only when cancelling an order created by GoFin. Omit for an externally created wallet-owned order; GoFin then verifies the on-chain owner and uses a fresh standalone approval.

original_submission.description: Optional exact echo of GoFin's saved submission when original_operation_id is supplied. Omit for externally created orders; a named-plan recovery step supplies it from the earlier create step.

coverage: Noncustodial Trigger V1 order placement, active/history reads, wallet-owned order cancellation, expiry and fill-state tracking from the Limit Order V2 on-chain account. Plain Token-2022 is accepted. Placement/cancellation reject configured transfer fees, transfer hooks, paused mints, and transfer extensions whose future escrow effects are not bounded. Recipient token-account checks are independent of mint metadata: memo-required accounts and accounts that disallow public credits are unsupported; confidential-transfer metadata alone is allowed when non-confidential credits are enabled. A full fill returns funded account rent only when that same finalized fill receipt proves the exact account closed from its funded balance to zero. If funded accounts remain open after fill, their balances stay tracked as refundable funding; automatic post-fill account cleanup is not supported. Externally created orders can be cancelled with a fresh standalone approval after exact on-chain ownership and escrow verification; GoFin-created orders retain parent-bound recovery accounting.
completion: The cancellation operation records a cancellation marker against the original submission; the original order operation owns fill and refund settlement.

semantics.external_order_cancel: fresh standalone approval only; verify wallet maker, live order PDA, finalized cancel event, exact token return and zero new account funding
semantics.full_fill_account_rent: returned only when the finalized fill receipt proves exact funded account pre-balance and zero post-balance; otherwise retained funding remains tracked and no post-fill cleanup operation is available
semantics.gofin_created_order_cancel: exact original operation and submission remain bound; original lifecycle owns fills and escrow refunds

name: kraken.account-transfer
description: Account Transfer

asset.description: Asset being transferred

asset_class.description: Specify the asset class of the asset being transferred

from.description: Public account ID of the source account (Example ABCD 1234 EFGH 5678)

to.description: Public account ID of the destination account (Example ABCD 1234 EFGH 5678)

position.description: Stable accounting position identity for this refundable account.

AccountingLocation.description: A link identifies principal flow; application-owned receipt verification proves its cash/position legs.

source.description:
Typed authority path used to approve this action. Older journal entries
omit this field and retain their original opaque mechanism string.

yolo_provenance.description: Present only when this audit was created under the protected Yolo gate.

treatment.description:
Venue meaning on this exact leg; generated fees are projected against
the sequence's prior credit, without requiring an initial holding there.

oneOf.description: Native order is terminal; execution quantities may be partial or zero.

maximum_costs.description: Complete fee ceilings by exact asset, shared across all stages and treatments.

CostTreatment.description: Prevent a proved expense included in a repayment/supply debit being charged twice.

oneOf.description:
Venue-calculated additional cash debit explicitly consented to by the
user. `CostBound.amount` is the finite upfront reservation, not a cap
on the ultimately proved fee. Supported only by narrowly reviewed
standalone operations.
Withheld from the gross proved credit, applied exactly once by the ledger.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Fresh exact approval for one linked authority revision, never a second fill owner.

A bounded noncustodial order or other protocol escrow lifecycle. The
ratio is minimum output atoms per filled input atom; fees are reserved
separately through `maximum_costs`.

A noncustodial escrow whose finalized fill becomes a typed position,
rather than spendable wallet credit. Refunds remain wallet cash.

conditional_position.description:
Optional non-custodial exposure created only when some escrow
input is finalized as filled. A no-fill cancellation proves zero.

oneOf.description:
A protocol request whose placement is pending and whose eventual
keeper outcome may change only these exact, anchored positions. This
does not represent wallet cash or escrow principal.

conditional_credits.description:
Optional cumulative wallet proceeds that may arise from a
finalized keeper fill. They are never available while the request
is merely placed; each positive progress row must pair with one
exact UsableCredit to `wallet_resource`.

conditional_pnl.description:
Optional realized PnL events that may exist only after a finalized
fill. Open/cancelled requests carry no rows.

protection.description:
Optional, explicitly reviewed reduce-only protection envelope.
Shared position locks are never inferred from a request's name;
adapters supply this only when the protocol binds the request to
the exact anchored position and threshold.

oneOf.description:
A bounded typed position movement. Unlike the legacy `Position`
constraint, this binds the exact protocol position kind.

An optional typed increase used only when a protocol may produce a
newly attributable position claim or no claim at all. Any present
effect remains bound to this exact key, kind and maximum.

Optional refundable account rent, for idempotent account-creation
instructions that can succeed without funding when the account appears
between preview and execution. When nonzero, adapters must emit a
balanced cash debit, typed refundable position and origin link.
Cumulative, receipt-backed lifecycle for rent-bearing accounts.
Long/short exposure quantities, never custody or borrowed principal.
Native-asset segregated margin exposure; the corresponding loan remains separate debt.
Realized collateral only; mark-to-market and unrealized PnL are excluded.

Bounds a finalized realized PnL event attached to an exact derivative
position. This is not cash, a credit, or a budget debit; the proved
wallet payout remains a separate effect.

Binds a protocol fee's native denomination to its separately accounted
typed Cost. This constraint creates no ledger movement or extra budget.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Proven mutation acknowledgment; monetary fills remain owned by the original operation.
Provenance only: matching cash/position/debt effects apply actual balances once.

Cumulative, receipt-backed state for an externally executable escrow.
`wallet_debit = escrow_deposit + input_transfer_fee` and
`escrow_deposit = input_filled + input_refunded + remaining_input`.
Input/output fees remain explicit Cost effects where they are actual
additional wallet debits; input token transfer fees are included here.

Cumulative, receipt-backed progress for an escrow that converts into a
position. `position_change` is not a wallet credit; it is paired with
an anchored PositionChange. Only `input_refunded` becomes wallet cash.
Cumulative exact funding and refund state for one protocol account.

Cumulative finalized state for a keeper-executable request. The
position changes are repeated cumulatively and paired with their
matching anchored PositionChange effects; this marker never creates
spendable cash.

credits.description:
Cumulative proceeds actually credited to the wallet for this
request. Omitted/empty means no spendable proceeds have been
proved, including an open or cancelled no-fill request.

protection.description: Exact protection terms decoded from the finalized request state.

realized_pnl.description: Cumulative finalized realized PnL events for this request.

oneOf.description:
Append-only realized PnL attributed to one finalized derivative
position event. `anchor` must match that event's anchored net position
change. It never creates or removes spendable wallet cash.

Proven principal committed to an external transfer but not yet
spendable at either custody location. The containing proof digest binds it.

Links an explicitly typed IncludedInDebit cost to the gross source
debit and net amount credited to an exact position. Application
adapters prove the conversion from finalized protocol evidence; the
engine verifies identities, arithmetic and that no source debit or
position movement is reused. This marker books no balance or budget.

Evidence-only denomination for one typed Cost row, such as a protocol
fee reported in collateral-token atoms while the ledger cost is margin
USD. `evidence_id` binds it to the same finalized protocol event.

Non-accounting evidence that an exact prior finalized transaction
changed the predecessor anchor for a protected position. The engine
validates the source operation and both canonical order rows before
using `source_anchor` for this one transition.

IncludedCostSource.description: Exact source identity for an included protocol cost conversion.

PendingRequestCreditBound.description:
Bounds a request's conditional proceeds in one exact wallet asset. The
same asset may be used by several requests, but may occur only once within
one request's bound set.

maximum_credit.description:
Optional venue/approval-defined upper limit. `None` avoids inventing
a cap for legitimate proceeds whose protocol amount is not bounded at
request creation.

PendingRequestCreditProgress.description:
Cumulative, finalized proceeds for a pending request. The recipient is
intentionally implicit and fixed to `PendingRequestProgress.wallet_resource`.

asset.description: PnL denomination, which may differ from the derivative notional asset.

position_lock_resource.description:
Exact position-scoped reservation shared by compatible protection
siblings. Empty on legacy records, which cannot grant a new lease.

PositionAnchor.description: Broker-owned previously proved backing. JSON evidence is interpreted by the reviewed application.

PositionAnchorBaseline.description:
Versioned, broker-captured pre-action position anchors bound to one preview.
It preserves the exact historical anchors relevant to the operation and
combines them with any newly scoped observer anchors for restart-safe
reconciliation.

PositionAnchorPredecessor.description:
A narrow, exact predecessor proof for a position transition after a
compatible protected sibling has already reduced the same exposure.

PositionEventOrder.description:
Canonical transaction order for one finalized position event. The exact
submission is included so an index cannot be detached from its transaction.

oneOf.description:
Protocol-owned liquidity position backed by one or more independently
accounted underlying assets. Receipt units stay in anchor evidence.

Application-reported investment equity, with units and redemption
restrictions retained in its verified anchor evidence.
Cash committed to a position's margin, distinct from exposure units.

Conditional close order type 
> Note: [Conditional close orders](https://support.kraken.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038640052-Conditional-Close) are triggered by execution of the primary order in the same quantity and opposite direction, but once triggered are __independent orders__ that may reduce or increase net position

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp (e.g. 2021-04-01T00:18:45Z) after which the matching engine should reject the new order request, in presence of latency or order queueing: min now() + 2 seconds, max now() + 60 seconds.

expiretm.description:
Expiry time on GTD orders can be set up to one month in future, it is specified as an absolute timestamp or as a number of seconds from now:
  * • `0` no expiration (default)
  * • `<n>` = unix timestamp of expiration time
  * • `+<n>` = expire `<n>` seconds from now, minimum 5 seconds
    * Note that URL encoding of the `+` character changes it to a space, so please use `%2b` followed by the number of seconds instead of `+`

oflags.description:
Comma delimited list of order flags

  * • `post` post-only order (available when ordertype = limit)
  * • `fcib` prefer fee in base currency (default if selling)
  * • `fciq` prefer fee in quote currency (default if buying, mutually exclusive with `fcib`)
  * • `nompp` (DEPRECATED) — disabling Market Price Protection for market orders is no longer supported. If supplied, the flag is accepted but ignored.

ordertype.description: The execution model of the order.

price.description:
Price:
* • Limit price for `limit` and `iceberg` orders
* • Trigger price for `stop-loss`, `stop-loss-limit`, `take-profit`, `take-profit-limit`, `trailing-stop` and `trailing-stop-limit` orders

Notes:
* • Relative Prices: Either `price` or `price2` can be preceded by `+`, `-`, or `#` to specify the order price as an offset relative to the last traded price. `+` adds the amount to, and `-` subtracts the amount from the last traded price. `#` will either add or subtract the amount to the last traded price, depending on the direction and order type used. Prices can also be suffixed with a `%` to signify the relative amount as a percentage, rather than an absolute price difference.
* • Trailing Stops: Must use a relative price for this field, namely the `+` prefix, from which the direction will be automatic based on if the original order is a buy or sell (no need to use `-` or `#`). The `%` suffix also works for these order types to use a relative percentage price.

price2.description:
Secondary Price:
* • Limit price for `stop-loss-limit`, `take-profit-limit` and `trailing-stop-limit` orders

Note:
* • Trailing Stops: Must use a relative price for this field, namely one of the `+` or `-` prefixes. This will provide the offset from the trigger price to the limit price, i.e. +0 would set the limit price equal to the trigger price. The `%` suffix also works for this field to use a relative percentage limit price.

reduce_only.description: If `true`, order will only reduce a currently open position, not increase it or open a new position.

starttm.description:
Scheduled start time, can be specified as an absolute timestamp or as a number of seconds in the future:

  * • `<n>` = unix timestamp of start time
  * • `+<n>` = schedule start time `<n>` seconds from now
    * Note that URL encoding of the `+` character changes it to a space, so please use `%2b` followed by the number of seconds instead of `+`

stptype.description:
Self Trade Prevention (STP) is a protection feature to prevent users from inadvertently or deliberately trading against themselves. To prevent a self-match, one of the following STP modes can be used to define which order(s) will be expired:
* • `cancel-newest`: arriving order will be canceled
* • `cancel-oldest`: resting order will be canceled
* • `cancel-both`: both arriving and resting orders will be canceled

timeinforce.description: Time-in-force of the order to specify how long it should remain in the order book before being cancelled. GTC (Good-'til-cancelled) is default if the parameter is omitted. IOC (immediate-or-cancel) will immediately execute the amount possible and cancel any remaining balance rather than resting in the book. GTD (good-'til-date), if specified, must coincide with a desired `expiretm`. FOK (fill-or-kill) will execute the full order immediately or cancel it entirely.

trigger.description:
Price signal used to trigger `stop-loss`, `stop-loss-limit`, `take-profit`, `take-profit-limit`, `trailing-stop` and `trailing-stop-limit` orders

Notes:
* • This `trigger` type will also be used for any associated conditional close orders.
* • To keep triggers serviceable, the last price will be used as fallback reference price during connectivity issues with external index feeds.

userref.description: This is an optional non-unique, numeric identifier which can associated with a number of orders by the client. This field is mutually exclusive with cl_ord_id parameter. `userref` is an optional user-specified integer id that can be associated with any number of orders. Many clients choose a `userref` corresponding to a unique integer id generated by their systems (e.g. a timestamp). However, because we don't enforce uniqueness on our side, it can also be used to easily group orders by pair, side, strategy, etc. This allows clients to more readily cancel or query information about orders in a particular group, with fewer API calls by using `userref` instead of our `txid`, where supported.

validate.description: If set to `true` the order will be validated only, it will not trade in the matching engine.

volume.description:

validates the source operation and both canonical order rows before

name: kraken.amend-order
description: Amend Order

cl_ord_id.description: The client identifier for the order to be amended. Either `txid` or `cl_ord_id` is required.

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp (e.g. 2021-04-01T00:18:45Z) after which the matching engine should reject the new order request, in presence of latency or order queueing. min now() + 2 seconds, max now() + 60 seconds.

display_qty.description: For `iceberg` orders only, it defines the new quantity to show in the book while the rest of order quantity remains hidden. Minimum value is 1 / 15 of remaining order quantity.

limit_price.description:
The new limit price restriction on the order (for order types that support limit price only).

The relative pricing can be set by using the `+`, `-` prefixes and/or `%` suffix. 
* • `+` adds the amount from the reference price, i.e. market rises 50 USD `"+50"`.
* • `-` subtracts the amount from the reference price, i.e. market drops 100 USD `"-100"`.

order_qty.description: The new order quantity in terms of the base asset.

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

pair.description: The `pair` is required on amends for non-crypto pairs, i.e. provide the pair symbol for xStocks.

post_only.description: An optional flag for `limit_price` amends. If `true`, the limit price change will be rejected if the order cannot be posted passively in the book.

trigger_price.description:
The new trigger price to activate the order (for triggered order types only). 

The relative pricing can be set by using the `+`, `-` prefixes and/or `%` suffix. 
* • `+` adds the amount from the reference price, i.e. market rises 50 USD `"+50"`.
* • `-` subtracts the amount from the reference price, i.e. market drops 100 USD `"-100"`.

Older journal records predate this field and deserialize as `None`.

position_baseline.description:
Finalized observer anchors captured before dispatch when this operation
needs a prior position state that is not already in the durable history.
This is immutable recovery context; it is never refreshed after submit.

coverage: Typed REST contract; consult the per-capability evidence matrix for verification.
completion: Verified operation-specific effects, never HTTP acknowledgment alone.

name: kraken.cancel-all-orders-after
description: Cancel All Orders After X

timeout.description: Duration (in seconds) to set/extend the timer, it should be less than 86400 seconds.

position.description: Stable accounting position identity for this refundable account.

AccountingLocation.description: A link identifies principal flow; application-owned receipt verification proves its cash/position legs.

source.description:
Typed authority path used to approve this action. Older journal entries
omit this field and retain their original opaque mechanism string.

yolo_provenance.description: Present only when this audit was created under the protected Yolo gate.

treatment.description:
Venue meaning on this exact leg; generated fees are projected against
the sequence's prior credit, without requiring an initial holding there.

oneOf.description: Native order is terminal; execution quantities may be partial or zero.

maximum_costs.description: Complete fee ceilings by exact asset, shared across all stages and treatments.

CostTreatment.description: Prevent a proved expense included in a repayment/supply debit being charged twice.

oneOf.description:
Venue-calculated additional cash debit explicitly consented to by the
user. `CostBound.amount` is the finite upfront reservation, not a cap
on the ultimately proved fee. Supported only by narrowly reviewed
standalone operations.
Withheld from the gross proved credit, applied exactly once by the ledger.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Fresh exact approval for one linked authority revision, never a second fill owner.

A bounded noncustodial order or other protocol escrow lifecycle. The
ratio is minimum output atoms per filled input atom; fees are reserved
separately through `maximum_costs`.

A noncustodial escrow whose finalized fill becomes a typed position,
rather than spendable wallet credit. Refunds remain wallet cash.

conditional_position.description:
Optional non-custodial exposure created only when some escrow
input is finalized as filled. A no-fill cancellation proves zero.

oneOf.description:
A protocol request whose placement is pending and whose eventual
keeper outcome may change only these exact, anchored positions. This
does not represent wallet cash or escrow principal.

conditional_credits.description:
Optional cumulative wallet proceeds that may arise from a
finalized keeper fill. They are never available while the request
is merely placed; each positive progress row must pair with one
exact UsableCredit to `wallet_resource`.

conditional_pnl.description:
Optional realized PnL events that may exist only after a finalized
fill. Open/cancelled requests carry no rows.

protection.description:
Optional, explicitly reviewed reduce-only protection envelope.
Shared position locks are never inferred from a request's name;
adapters supply this only when the protocol binds the request to
the exact anchored position and threshold.

oneOf.description:
A bounded typed position movement. Unlike the legacy `Position`
constraint, this binds the exact protocol position kind.

An optional typed increase used only when a protocol may produce a
newly attributable position claim or no claim at all. Any present
effect remains bound to this exact key, kind and maximum.

Optional refundable account rent, for idempotent account-creation
instructions that can succeed without funding when the account appears
between preview and execution. When nonzero, adapters must emit a
balanced cash debit, typed refundable position and origin link.
Cumulative, receipt-backed lifecycle for rent-bearing accounts.
Long/short exposure quantities, never custody or borrowed principal.
Native-asset segregated margin exposure; the corresponding loan remains separate debt.
Realized collateral only; mark-to-market and unrealized PnL are excluded.

Bounds a finalized realized PnL event attached to an exact derivative
position. This is not cash, a credit, or a budget debit; the proved
wallet payout remains a separate effect.

Binds a protocol fee's native denomination to its separately accounted
typed Cost. This constraint creates no ledger movement or extra budget.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Proven mutation acknowledgment; monetary fills remain owned by the original operation.
Provenance only: matching cash/position/debt effects apply actual balances once.

Cumulative, receipt-backed state for an externally executable escrow.
`wallet_debit = escrow_deposit + input_transfer_fee` and
`escrow_deposit = input_filled + input_refunded + remaining_input`.
Input/output fees remain explicit Cost effects where they are actual
additional wallet debits; input token transfer fees are included here.

Cumulative, receipt-backed progress for an escrow that converts into a
position. `position_change` is not a wallet credit; it is paired with
an anchored PositionChange. Only `input_refunded` becomes wallet cash.
Cumulative exact funding and refund state for one protocol account.

Cumulative finalized state for a keeper-executable request. The
position changes are repeated cumulatively and paired with their
matching anchored PositionChange effects; this marker never creates
spendable cash.

credits.description:
Cumulative proceeds actually credited to the wallet for this
request. Omitted/empty means no spendable proceeds have been
proved, including an open or cancelled no-fill request.

protection.description: Exact protection terms decoded from the finalized request state.

realized_pnl.description: Cumulative finalized realized PnL events for this request.

oneOf.description:
Append-only realized PnL attributed to one finalized derivative
position event. `anchor` must match that event's anchored net position
change. It never creates or removes spendable wallet cash.

Proven principal committed to an external transfer but not yet
spendable at either custody location. The containing proof digest binds it.

Links an explicitly typed IncludedInDebit cost to the gross source
debit and net amount credited to an exact position. Application
adapters prove the conversion from finalized protocol evidence; the
engine verifies identities, arithmetic and that no source debit or
position movement is reused. This marker books no balance or budget.

Evidence-only denomination for one typed Cost row, such as a protocol
fee reported in collateral-token atoms while the ledger cost is margin
USD. `evidence_id` binds it to the same finalized protocol event.

Non-accounting evidence that an exact prior finalized transaction
changed the predecessor anchor for a protected position. The engine
validates the source operation and both canonical order rows before
using `source_anchor` for this one transition.

IncludedCostSource.description: Exact source identity for an included protocol cost conversion.

PendingRequestCreditBound.description:
Bounds a request's conditional proceeds in one exact wallet asset. The
same asset may be used by several requests, but may occur only once within
one request's bound set.

maximum_credit.description:
Optional venue/approval-defined upper limit. `None` avoids inventing
a cap for legitimate proceeds whose protocol amount is not bounded at
request creation.

PendingRequestCreditProgress.description:
Cumulative, finalized proceeds for a pending request. The recipient is
intentionally implicit and fixed to `PendingRequestProgress.wallet_resource`.

asset.description: PnL denomination, which may differ from the derivative notional asset.

position_lock_resource.description:
Exact position-scoped reservation shared by compatible protection
siblings. Empty on legacy records, which cannot grant a new lease.

PositionAnchor.description: Broker-owned previously proved backing. JSON evidence is interpreted by the reviewed application.

PositionAnchorBaseline.description:
Versioned, broker-captured pre-action position anchors bound to one preview.
It preserves the exact historical anchors relevant to the operation and
combines them with any newly scoped observer anchors for restart-safe
reconciliation.

PositionAnchorPredecessor.description:
A narrow, exact predecessor proof for a position transition after a
compatible protected sibling has already reduced the same exposure.

PositionEventOrder.description:
Canonical transaction order for one finalized position event. The exact
submission is included so an index cannot be detached from its transaction.

oneOf.description:
Protocol-owned liquidity position backed by one or more independently
accounted underlying assets. Receipt units stay in anchor evidence.

Application-reported investment equity, with units and redemption
restrictions retained in its verified anchor evidence.
Cash committed to a position's margin, distinct from exposure units.

Assets held by a noncustodial protocol request or order. This balance
is not wallet cash and becomes usable only after separately verified
refund or settlement evidence.

Refundable native value held as rent in a wallet-owned account. This is
distinct from protocol collateral and remains an asset until returned.

binding.description: Frozen exact execution fields and enforceable bounds, excluding observation times.

Quantity.description: Canonical arbitrary-precision unsigned atomic units, serialized as a string.

ResourceId.description: Resolved physical custody/signer identity, never merely a user-provided alias.

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

generation.description: Unique for each enablement; prevents disable/re-enable from reviving old authority.

authorization_source.description:
Safe history projection derived from the typed approval audit. Older

This is immutable recovery context; it is never refreshed after submit.

coverage: Typed REST contract; consult the per-capability evidence matrix for verification.
completion: Verified operation-specific effects, never HTTP acknowledgment alone.

name: kraken.edit-order
description: Edit Order

asset_class.description: This parameter is required on requests for non-crypto pairs, i.e. use `tokenized_asset` for xStocks.

cancel_response.description: Used to interpret if client wants to receive pending replace, before the order is completely replaced

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp (e.g. 2021-04-01T00:18:45Z) after which the matching engine should reject the new order request, in presence of latency or order queueing. min now() + 2 seconds, max now() + 60 seconds.

displayvol.description: For `iceberg` orders only, it defines the quantity to show in the book while the rest of order quantity remains hidden. Minimum value is 1 / 15 of `volume`.

oflags.description: Comma delimited list of order flags. Only these flags can be changed: - post post-only order (available when ordertype = limit). All the flags from the parent order are retained except post-only. post-only needs to be explicitly mentioned on edit request.

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

price.description:
Price:
* Limit price for `limit` and `iceberg` orders
* Trigger price for `stop-loss`, `stop-loss-limit`, `take-profit`, `take-profit-limit`, `trailing-stop` and `trailing-stop-limit` orders

Notes:
* Relative Prices: Either `price` or `price2` can be preceded by `+`, `-`, or `#` to specify the order price as an offset relative to the last traded price. `+` adds the amount to, and `-` subtracts the amount from the last traded price. `#` will either add or subtract the amount to the last traded price, depending on the direction and order type used. Prices can also be suffixed with a `%` to signify the relative amount as a percentage, rather than an absolute price difference.
* Trailing Stops: Must use a relative price for this field, namely the `+` prefix, from which the direction will be automatic based on if the original order is a buy or sell (no need to use `-` or `#`). The `%` suffix also works for these order types to use a relative percentage price.

price2.description:
Secondary Price:
* Limit price for `stop-loss-limit`, `take-profit-limit` and `trailing-stop-limit` orders
Note:
* Trailing Stops: Must use a relative price for this field, namely one of the `+` or `-` prefixes. This will provide the offset from the trigger price to the limit price, i.e. +0 would set the limit price equal to the trigger price. The `%` suffix also works for this field to use a relative percentage limit price.

userref.description:

`userref` is an optional user-specified integer id associated with edit request. 
 >  Note: userref from parent order will not be retained on the new order after edit.

name: kraken.wallet-transfer
description: Request Wallet Transfer

asset.description: Asset to transfer (asset ID or `altname`)

position.description: Stable accounting position identity for this refundable account.

AccountingLocation.description: A link identifies principal flow; application-owned receipt verification proves its cash/position legs.

source.description:
Typed authority path used to approve this action. Older journal entries
omit this field and retain their original opaque mechanism string.

yolo_provenance.description: Present only when this audit was created under the protected Yolo gate.

treatment.description:
Venue meaning on this exact leg; generated fees are projected against
the sequence's prior credit, without requiring an initial holding there.

oneOf.description: Native order is terminal; execution quantities may be partial or zero.

maximum_costs.description: Complete fee ceilings by exact asset, shared across all stages and treatments.

CostTreatment.description: Prevent a proved expense included in a repayment/supply debit being charged twice.

oneOf.description:
Venue-calculated additional cash debit explicitly consented to by the
user. `CostBound.amount` is the finite upfront reservation, not a cap
on the ultimately proved fee. Supported only by narrowly reviewed
standalone operations.
Withheld from the gross proved credit, applied exactly once by the ledger.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Fresh exact approval for one linked authority revision, never a second fill owner.

A bounded noncustodial order or other protocol escrow lifecycle. The
ratio is minimum output atoms per filled input atom; fees are reserved
separately through `maximum_costs`.

A noncustodial escrow whose finalized fill becomes a typed position,
rather than spendable wallet credit. Refunds remain wallet cash.

conditional_position.description:
Optional non-custodial exposure created only when some escrow
input is finalized as filled. A no-fill cancellation proves zero.

oneOf.description:
A protocol request whose placement is pending and whose eventual
keeper outcome may change only these exact, anchored positions. This
does not represent wallet cash or escrow principal.

conditional_credits.description:
Optional cumulative wallet proceeds that may arise from a
finalized keeper fill. They are never available while the request
is merely placed; each positive progress row must pair with one
exact UsableCredit to `wallet_resource`.

conditional_pnl.description:
Optional realized PnL events that may exist only after a finalized
fill. Open/cancelled requests carry no rows.

protection.description:
Optional, explicitly reviewed reduce-only protection envelope.
Shared position locks are never inferred from a request's name;
adapters supply this only when the protocol binds the request to
the exact anchored position and threshold.

oneOf.description:
A bounded typed position movement. Unlike the legacy `Position`
constraint, this binds the exact protocol position kind.

An optional typed increase used only when a protocol may produce a
newly attributable position claim or no claim at all. Any present
effect remains bound to this exact key, kind and maximum.

Optional refundable account rent, for idempotent account-creation
instructions that can succeed without funding when the account appears
between preview and execution. When nonzero, adapters must emit a
balanced cash debit, typed refundable position and origin link.
Cumulative, receipt-backed lifecycle for rent-bearing accounts.
Long/short exposure quantities, never custody or borrowed principal.
Native-asset segregated margin exposure; the corresponding loan remains separate debt.
Realized collateral only; mark-to-market and unrealized PnL are excluded.

Bounds a finalized realized PnL event attached to an exact derivative
position. This is not cash, a credit, or a budget debit; the proved
wallet payout remains a separate effect.

Binds a protocol fee's native denomination to its separately accounted
typed Cost. This constraint creates no ledger movement or extra budget.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Proven mutation acknowledgment; monetary fills remain owned by the original operation.
Provenance only: matching cash/position/debt effects apply actual balances once.

Cumulative, receipt-backed state for an externally executable escrow.
`wallet_debit = escrow_deposit + input_transfer_fee` and
`escrow_deposit = input_filled + input_refunded + remaining_input`.
Input/output fees remain explicit Cost effects where they are actual
additional wallet debits; input token transfer fees are included here.

Versioned, broker-captured pre-action position anchors bound to one preview.
It preserves the exact historical anchors relevant to the operation and
combines them with any newly scoped observer anchors for restart-safe
reconciliation.

PositionAnchorPredecessor.description:
A narrow, exact predecessor proof for a position transition after a
compatible protected sibling has already reduced the same exposure.

PositionEventOrder.description:
Canonical transaction order for one finalized position event. The exact
submission is included so an index cannot be detached from its transaction.

oneOf.description:
Protocol-owned liquidity position backed by one or more independently
accounted underlying assets. Receipt units stay in anchor evidence.

Application-reported investment equity, with units and redemption
restrictions retained in its verified anchor evidence.
Cash committed to a position's margin, distinct from exposure units.

Assets held by a noncustodial protocol request or order. This balance
is not wallet cash and becomes usable only after separately verified
refund or settlement evidence.

Refundable native value held as rent in a wallet-owned account. This is
distinct from protocol collateral and remains an asset until returned.

on the ultimately proved fee. Supported only by narrowly reviewed

A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Fresh exact approval for one linked authority revision, never a second fill owner.

A bounded noncustodial order or other protocol escrow lifecycle. The
ratio is minimum output atoms per filled input atom; fees are reserved
separately through `maximum_costs`.

rather than spendable wallet credit. Refunds remain wallet cash.

conditional_position.description:
Optional non-custodial exposure created only when some escrow
input is finalized as filled. A no-fill cancellation proves zero.

oneOf.description:
A protocol request whose placement is pending and whose eventual
keeper outcome may change only these exact, anchored positions. This
does not represent wallet cash or escrow principal.

conditional_credits.description:
Optional cumulative wallet proceeds that may arise from a
finalized keeper fill. They are never available while the request
is merely placed; each positive progress row must pair with one
exact UsableCredit to `wallet_resource`.

conditional_pnl.description:
Optional realized PnL events that may exist only after a finalized
fill. Open/cancelled requests carry no rows.

protection.description:
Optional, explicitly reviewed reduce-only protection envelope.
Shared position locks are never inferred from a request's name;
adapters supply this only when the protocol binds the request to
the exact anchored position and threshold.

oneOf.description:
A bounded typed position movement. Unlike the legacy `Position`
constraint, this binds the exact protocol position kind.

An optional typed increase used only when a protocol may produce a
newly attributable position claim or no claim at all. Any present
effect remains bound to this exact key, kind and maximum.

Optional refundable account rent, for idempotent account-creation
instructions that can succeed without funding when the account appears
between preview and execution. When nonzero, adapters must emit a
balanced cash debit, typed refundable position and origin link.
Cumulative, receipt-backed lifecycle for rent-bearing accounts.
Long/short exposure quantities, never custody or borrowed principal.
Native-asset segregated margin exposure; the corresponding loan remains separate debt.
Realized collateral only; mark-to-market and unrealized PnL are excluded.

Bounds a finalized realized PnL event attached to an exact derivative
position. This is not cash, a credit, or a budget debit; the proved
wallet payout remains a separate effect.

Binds a protocol fee's native denomination to its separately accounted
typed Cost. This constraint creates no ledger movement or extra budget.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Proven mutation acknowledgment; monetary fills remain owned by the original operation.
Provenance only: matching cash/position/debt effects apply actual balances once.

Cumulative, receipt-backed state for an externally executable escrow.
`wallet_debit = escrow_deposit + input_transfer_fee` and
`escrow_deposit = input_filled + input_refunded + remaining_input`.
Input/output fees remain explicit Cost effects where they are actual
additional wallet debits; input token transfer fees are included here.

Cumulative, receipt-backed progress for an escrow that converts into a
position. `position_change` is not a wallet credit; it is paired with
an anchored PositionChange. Only `input_refunded` becomes wallet cash.
Cumulative exact funding and refund state for one protocol account.

Cumulative finalized state for a keeper-executable request. The
position changes are repeated cumulatively and paired with their
matching anchored PositionChange effects; this marker never creates
spendable cash.

credits.description:
Cumulative proceeds actually credited to the wallet for this
request. Omitted/empty means no spendable proceeds have been
proved, including an open or cancelled no-fill request.

protection.description: Exact protection terms decoded from the finalized request state.

realized_pnl.description: Cumulative finalized realized PnL events for this request.

oneOf.description:
Append-only realized PnL attributed to one finalized derivative
position event. `anchor` must match that event's anchored net position
change. It never creates or removes spendable wallet cash.

Proven principal committed to an external transfer but not yet
spendable at either custody location. The containing proof digest binds it.

Links an explicitly typed IncludedInDebit cost to the gross source
debit and net amount credited to an exact position. Application
adapters prove the conversion from finalized protocol evidence; the
engine verifies identities, arithmetic and that no source debit or
position movement is reused. This marker books no balance or budget.

Evidence-only denomination for one typed Cost row, such as a protocol
fee reported in collateral-token atoms while the ledger cost is margin
USD. `evidence_id` binds it to the same finalized protocol event.

Non-accounting evidence that an exact prior finalized transaction
changed the predecessor anchor for a protected position. The engine
validates the source operation and both canonical order rows before
using `source_anchor` for this one transition.

IncludedCostSource.description: Exact source identity for an included protocol cost conversion.

request creation.

Cumulative, finalized proceeds for a pending request. The recipient is
intentionally implicit and fixed to `PendingRequestProgress.wallet_resource`.

description: Edit order

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

qtyMode.description:
Determines how the updated size is interpreted, defaulting to 'RELATIVE'.

'ABSOLUTE' means that the total order size, including past fills, is set to `size`.
'RELATIVE' means that the current open order size is set to `size`.

trailingStopDeviationUnit.description:
Only relevant for trailing stop orders.

This defines how the trailing trigger price is calculated from the requested trigger signal.
For example, if the max deviation is set to 10, the unit is 'PERCENT', and the underlying order is a sell,
then the trigger price will never be more then 10% below the trigger signal.
Similarly, if the deviation is 100, the unit is 'QUOTE_CURRENCY', the underlying order is a sell, and the
contract is quoted in USD, then the trigger price will never be more than $100 below the trigger signal.

trailingStopMaxDeviation.description:
Only relevant for trailing stop orders. Maximum value of 50%, minimum value of 0.1% for 'PERCENT' 'maxDeviationUnit'.

Is the maximum distance the trailing stop's trigger price may trail behind the requested trigger signal.
It defines the threshold at which the trigger price updates.

description: Batch order management

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

cliOrdId.description: The order identity that is specified from the user. It must be globally unique.

limitPrice.description:
The limit price associated with the order. If placing a `trailing_stop` order then leave
undefined.

orderType.description:
The order type:

- `lmt` - a limit order
- `post` - a post-only limit order
- `mkt` - an immediate-or-cancel order with 1% price protection
- `stp` - a stop order
- `take_profit` - a take profit order
- `ioc` - an immediate-or-cancel order
- `trailing_stop` - a trailing stop order
- `fok` - fill-or-kill order

reduceOnly.description:
Set as 'true' if you wish the order to only reduce an existing position. Any order which
increases an existing position will be rejected. Default 'false'.

size.description: The size associated with the order.

stopPrice.description:
The stop price associated with a stop order. Required if `orderType` is `stp`.
Note that for `stp` orders, `limitPrice` is also required and denotes the worst price at
which the `stp` order can get filled

trailingStopDeviationUnit.description:
Required if the order type is `trailing_stop`.

This defines how the trailing trigger price is calculated from the requested trigger
signal. For example, if the max deviation is set to 10, the unit is 'PERCENT', and the
underlying order is a sell, then the trigger price will never be more then 10% below the
trigger signal. Similarly, if the deviation is 100, the unit is 'QUOTE_CURRENCY', the
underlying order is a sell, and the contract is quoted in USD, then the trigger price
will never be more than $100 below the trigger signal.

trailingStopMaxDeviation.description:
Required if the order type is `trailing_stop`.

Is the maximum distance the trailing stop's trigger price may trail behind the requested trigger signal.
It defines the threshold at which the trigger price updates.

limitPrice.description: The limit price associated with the order.

qtyMode.description:
Determines how the updated size is interpreted, defaulting to 'RELATIVE'.

'ABSOLUTE' means that the total order size, including past fills, is set to `size`.
'RELATIVE' means that the current open order size is set to `size`.

size.description: The size associated with the order.

stopPrice.description:
The stop price associated with a stop order. Required if old orderType is stp.

Note that for `stp` orders, `limitPrice` is also required and denotes the worst
price at which the stp order can get filled.

trailingStopDeviationUnit.description:
Only relevant for trailing stop orders.

This defines how the trailing trigger price is calculated from the requested trigger
signal. For example, if the max deviation is set to 10, the unit is 'PERCENT', and
the underlying order is a sell, then the trigger price will never be more then 10%
below the trigger signal. Similarly, if the deviation is 100, the unit is
'QUOTE_CURRENCY', the underlying order is a sell, and the contract is quoted in USD,
then the trigger price will never be more than $100 below the trigger signal.

trailingStopMaxDeviation.description:
Only relevant for trailing stop orders. Maximum value of 50%, minimum value of 0.1%
for 'PERCENT' 'maxDeviationUnit'.

Is the maximum distance the trailing stop's trigger price may trail behind the
requested trigger signal. It defines the threshold at which the trigger price
updates.

broker.description:
Valid Broker IIBAN on whose behalf the order is sent. The format must follow the
usual IIBAN pattern `XXXX YYYY ZZZZ WWWW` or machine pattern `XXXXYYYYZZZZWWWW`.

Note: This is currently available exclusively in the Kraken pre-prod environments.

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

position.description: Stable accounting position identity for this refundable account.

AccountingLocation.description: A link identifies principal flow; application-owned receipt verification proves its cash/position legs.

source.description:
Typed authority path used to approve this action. Older journal entries
omit this field and retain their original opaque mechanism string.

yolo_provenance.description: Present only when this audit was created under the protected Yolo gate.

treatment.description:
Venue meaning on this exact leg; generated fees are projected against
the sequence's prior credit, without requiring an initial holding there.

oneOf.description: Native order is terminal; execution quantities may be partial or zero.

maximum_costs.description: Complete fee ceilings by exact asset, shared across all stages and treatments.

CostTreatment.description: Prevent a proved expense included in a repayment/supply debit being charged twice.

oneOf.description:
Venue-calculated additional cash debit explicitly consented to by the
user. `CostBound.amount` is the finite upfront reservation, not a cap
on the ultimately proved fee. Supported only by narrowly reviewed
standalone operations.
Withheld from the gross proved credit, applied exactly once by the ledger.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Fresh exact approval for one linked authority revision, never a second fill owner.

A bounded noncustodial order or other protocol escrow lifecycle. The
ratio is minimum output atoms per filled input atom; fees are reserved
separately through `maximum_costs`.

A noncustodial escrow whose finalized fill becomes a typed position,
rather than spendable wallet credit. Refunds remain wallet cash.

conditional_position.description:
Optional non-custodial exposure created only when some escrow
input is finalized as filled. A no-fill cancellation proves zero.

oneOf.description:
A protocol request whose placement is pending and whose eventual
keeper outcome may change only these exact, anchored positions. This
does not represent wallet cash or escrow principal.

conditional_credits.description:
Optional cumulative wallet proceeds that may arise from a
finalized keeper fill. They are never available while the request
is merely placed; each positive progress row must pair with one
exact UsableCredit to `wallet_resource`.

conditional_pnl.description:
Optional realized PnL events that may exist only after a finalized
fill. Open/cancelled requests carry no rows.

protection.description:
Optional, explicitly reviewed reduce-only protection envelope.
Shared position locks are never inferred from a request's name;
adapters supply this only when the protocol binds the request to
the exact anchored position and threshold.

oneOf.description:
A bounded typed position movement. Unlike the legacy `Position`
constraint, this binds the exact protocol position kind.

An optional typed increase used only when a protocol may produce a
newly attributable position claim or no claim at all. Any present
effect remains bound to this exact key, kind and maximum.

Optional refundable account rent, for idempotent account-creation
instructions that can succeed without funding when the account appears
between preview and execution. When nonzero, adapters must emit a
balanced cash debit, typed refundable position and origin link.
Cumulative, receipt-backed lifecycle for rent-bearing accounts.
Long/short exposure quantities, never custody or borrowed principal.
Native-asset segregated margin exposure; the corresponding loan remains separate debt.
Realized collateral only; mark-to-market and unrealized PnL are excluded.

Bounds a finalized realized PnL event attached to an exact derivative
position. This is not cash, a credit, or a budget debit; the proved
wallet payout remains a separate effect.

Binds a protocol fee's native denomination to its separately accounted
typed Cost. This constraint creates no ledger movement or extra budget.
A separately authorized request to remove the remainder of one durable submission.
Proven mutation acknowledgment; monetary fills remain owned by the original operation.
Provenance only: matching cash/position/debt effects apply actual balances once.

Cumulative, receipt-backed state for an externally executable escrow.
`wallet_debit = escrow_deposit + input_transfer_fee` and
`escrow_deposit = input_filled + input_refunded + remaining_input`.
Input/output fees remain explicit Cost effects where they are actual
additional wallet debits; input token transfer fees are included here.

Cumulative, receipt-backed progress for an escrow that converts into a
position. `position_change` is not a wallet credit; it is paired with
an anchored PositionChange. Only `input_refunded` becomes wallet cash.
Cumulative exact funding and refund state for one protocol account.

Cumulative finalized state for a keeper-executable request. The
position changes are repeated cumulatively and paired with their
matching anchored PositionChange effects; this marker never creates
spendable cash.

credits.description:
Cumulative proceeds actually credited to the wallet for this
request. Omitted/empty means no spendable proceeds have been
proved, including an open or cancelled no-fill request.

protection.description: Exact protection terms decoded from the finalized request state.

realized_pnl.description: Cumulative finalized realized PnL events for this request.

oneOf.description:
Append-only realized PnL attributed to one finalized derivative
position event. `anchor` must match that event's anchored net position
change. It never creates or removes spendable wallet cash.

Proven principal committed to an external transfer but not yet
spendable at either custody location. The containing proof digest binds it.

Links an explicitly typed IncludedInDebit cost to the gross source
debit and net amount credited to an exact position. Application
adapters prove the conversion from finalized protocol evidence; the
engine verifies identities, arithmetic and that no source debit or
position movement is reused. This marker books no balance or budget.

Evidence-only denomination for one typed Cost row, such as a protocol
fee reported in collateral-token atoms while the ledger cost is margin
USD. `evidence_id` binds it to the same finalized protocol event.

Non-accounting evidence that an exact prior finalized transaction
changed the predecessor anchor for a protected position. The engine
validates the source operation and both canonical order rows before
using `source_anchor` for this one transition.

IncludedCostSource.description: Exact source identity for an included protocol cost conversion.

PendingRequestCreditBound.description:
Bounds a request's conditional proceeds in one exact wallet asset. The
same asset may be used by several requests, but may occur only once within

maximum_credit.description:
Optional venue/approval-defined upper limit. `None` avoids inventing
a cap for legitimate proceeds whose protocol amount is not bounded at
request creation.

PendingRequestCreditProgress.description:
Cumulative, finalized proceeds for a pending request. The recipient is

Exact position-scoped reservation shared by compatible protection

Cash committed to a position's margin, distinct from exposure units.

name: krakenfutures.set-self-trade-strategy
description: Update self trade strategy

strategy.description:
Self trade matching behaviour:

- `REJECT_TAKER` - default behaviour, rejects the taker order that would match against a maker order from any sub-account
- `CANCEL_MAKER_SELF` - only cancels the maker order if it is from the same account that sent the taker order
- `CANCEL_MAKER_CHILD` - only allows master to cancel its own maker orders and orders from its sub-account
- `CANCEL_MAKER_ANY` - allows both master accounts and their subaccounts to cancel maker orders

position. This is not cash, a credit, or a budget debit; the proved
wallet payout remains a separate effect.

Binds a protocol fee's native denomination to its separately accounted
typed Cost. This constraint creates no ledger movement or extra budget.

PendingRequestCreditBound.description:
Bounds a request's conditional proceeds in one exact wallet asset. The
same asset may be used by several requests, but may occur only once within
one request's bound set.

maximum_credit.description:
Optional venue/approval-defined upper limit. `None` avoids inventing
a cap for legitimate proceeds whose protocol amount is not bounded at
request creation.

asset.description: PnL denomination, which may differ from the derivative notional asset.

position_lock_resource.description:
Exact position-scoped reservation shared by compatible protection
siblings. Empty on legacy records, which cannot grant a new lease.

PositionAnchor.description: Broker-owned previously proved backing. JSON evidence is interpreted by the reviewed application.

oneOf.description:
Protocol-owned liquidity position backed by one or more independently
accounted underlying assets. Receipt units stay in anchor evidence.

Application-reported investment equity, with units and redemption
restrictions retained in its verified anchor evidence.
Cash committed to a position's margin, distinct from exposure units.

Assets held by a noncustodial protocol request or order. This balance
is not wallet cash and becomes usable only after separately verified
refund or settlement evidence.

Refundable native value held as rent in a wallet-owned account. This is
distinct from protocol collateral and remains an asset until returned.

Quantity.description: Canonical arbitrary-precision unsigned atomic units, serialized as a string.

ResourceId.description: Resolved physical custody/signer identity, never merely a user-provided alias.

data.description: Original nonce/client identity and receipt correlation data. No signed bytes or secrets.

action_deadline.description: Broker-resolved relative deadline, immutable for this plan attempt.

binding.description: Frozen exact execution fields and enforceable bounds, excluding observation times.

coverage: Rust implementation; synthetic and fixed-fork evidence recorded separately. Human/mainnet acceptance remains pending. Also: Exact conversion to a wallet-owned wrapped-SOL token account, idempotent associated-account creation when absent under an explicit rent cap, simulation, durable identity, and finalized native/token proof.
completion: Writes require canonical original transaction proof, confirmations, bounded actual gas, application-specific events and inclusion-block post-state. Also: Settles only after finalized SOL lamport and wrapped-token deltas match the conversion, any new wallet-owned rent funding, and network fee.

semantics.amount: Exact decimal asset quantity; no floating-point conversion or rounding.
semantics.bounded_all: Supported full-balance operations require finite max_amount. Cash sweeps freeze observed units; full Aave repayment/withdrawal proves zero remaining scaled debt/claim. Every actual write receives a fresh preview and authorization.
semantics.deadline_example: Fixed schema illustration; replace with the current Unix timestamp plus 120 seconds before preview.
semantics.retry: Reconcile the original persisted hash, never blind replay.

semantics.account_creation: Creates only the wallet's associated token address, with bounded rent funding; existing accounts are preserved.

bounded_authorization.plan_authorization_duration: finite parent plan duration; candidate freshness and blockhash expiry remain independent
bounded_authorization.scope: fixed wallet, cluster, wrapped-SOL mint and wallet token account
